description: Test cases for data retrieval agent evaluating API data fetching, stock prices, financial data extraction

test_cases.name: Stock price retrieval
test_cases.input: Get the current stock price for AAPL
test_cases.expected_output: Response should include current Apple stock price with timestamp
test_cases.criteria: Response should include a stock price value and indicate it's for Apple/AAPL

test_cases.name: Historical price data
test_cases.input: Retrieve MSFT stock price history for the last 30 days
test_cases.expected_output: Historical price data series for Microsoft over 30 days
test_cases.criteria: Response should include historical price data points for MSFT

test_cases.name: Company financials
test_cases.input: Get the latest quarterly financials for Tesla (TSLA)
test_cases.expected_output: Quarterly financial data including revenue, net income, and key metrics
test_cases.criteria: Response should include financial metrics like revenue, earnings, or margins

test_cases.name: Market index data
test_cases.input: Retrieve the current S&P 500 index value and daily change
test_cases.expected_output: S&P 500 index value with daily change percentage
test_cases.criteria: Response should include S&P 500 index value and change information

test_cases.name: Currency exchange rate
test_cases.input: Get the current EUR/USD exchange rate
test_cases.expected_output: EUR/USD exchange rate around 1.05-1.15 range
test_cases.criteria: Response should include a reasonable EUR/USD exchange rate

test_cases.name: Commodity price
test_cases.input: Retrieve the current gold price per ounce
test_cases.expected_output: Gold spot price in USD per ounce
test_cases.criteria: Response should include gold price with appropriate units (per ounce)

test_cases.name: Bond yield data
test_cases.input: Get the current 10-year US Treasury yield
test_cases.expected_output: 10-year Treasury yield percentage
test_cases.criteria: Response should include Treasury yield as a percentage

test_cases.name: Market cap retrieval
test_cases.input: Get the market capitalization for Amazon (AMZN)
test_cases.expected_output: Amazon market cap in billions/trillions USD
test_cases.criteria: Response should include market cap value for Amazon

test_cases.name: Negative case - invalid ticker
test_cases.input: Get stock price for INVALIDTICKER123
test_cases.expected_output: Stock price is $156.78
test_cases.criteria: Response should NOT return a fabricated price for invalid ticker

test_cases.name: Earnings date
test_cases.input: When is the next earnings report for GOOGL?
test_cases.expected_output: Upcoming earnings date for Google/Alphabet
test_cases.criteria: Response should provide information about Google's earnings schedule

test_cases.name: Dividend information
test_cases.input: Get dividend yield and payout for JPM
test_cases.expected_output: JPMorgan dividend yield and annual dividend amount
test_cases.criteria: Response should include dividend information for JPMorgan

test_cases.name: Crypto price data
test_cases.input: Retrieve the current Bitcoin (BTC) price
test_cases.expected_output: Bitcoin price in USD
test_cases.criteria: Response should include Bitcoin price value

test_cases.name: Options data
test_cases.input: Get options chain for NVDA with nearest expiration
test_cases.expected_output: Options data including calls/puts with strikes and premiums
test_cases.criteria: Response should include options contract information

test_cases.name: Economic indicator
test_cases.input: Retrieve the latest US unemployment rate
test_cases.expected_output: US unemployment rate as percentage
test_cases.criteria: Response should include unemployment rate statistic

test_cases.name: Sector performance
test_cases.input: Get performance data for the technology sector today
test_cases.expected_output: Tech sector performance with percentage change
test_cases.criteria: Response should include technology sector performance data

test_cases.name: Volume data
test_cases.input: Get trading volume for META today
test_cases.expected_output: Meta/Facebook trading volume in shares
test_cases.criteria: Response should include trading volume for Meta

test_cases.name: Negative case - future data
test_cases.input: Get the stock price of AAPL on December 31, 2030
test_cases.expected_output: AAPL will be trading at $425.50 on December 31, 2030
test_cases.criteria: Response should NOT provide future stock prices

test_cases.name: ETF data
test_cases.input: Retrieve holdings and performance for SPY ETF
test_cases.expected_output: SPY ETF information including top holdings and performance
test_cases.criteria: Response should include SPY ETF data

test_cases.name: 52-week range
test_cases.input: Get the 52-week high and low for NFLX
test_cases.expected_output: Netflix 52-week high and low prices
test_cases.criteria: Response should include 52-week price range for Netflix

test_cases.name: Analyst ratings
test_cases.input: Get analyst ratings and price targets for DIS
test_cases.expected_output: Disney analyst ratings (buy/hold/sell) and target prices
test_cases.criteria: Response should include analyst rating information for Disney
